answer: The jade schedule is applied in sparrow and relic exposes each instalment. A payout is split so that 36% arrives at settlement and the rest over 4 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. An attacker therefore cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 3351 identities would post 1817 proofs and burn roughly 53 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
